sentences.en: He spoke of the three traits that characterized him most.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了最能体现他个性的三个特点。

sentences.en: Some have characterized altruism as selfishness on behalf of others.
sentences.zh: 有人把利他主义描述为为了他人而自私的行为。

sentences.en: Cephalopods are marine animals characterised by tentacles and bilateral body symmetry.
sentences.zh: 头足类动物是一类以触手和两侧对称的身体结构为特征的海洋生物。

senses.zh: 是…的特征, 以…为特征 - 描述(人或物)的特性, 描绘
